Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services

Class PolicyJDBCService

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.services.PolicyJDBCService
@Service public class PolicyJDBCService extends Object
Service class that provides operations related to policies via JDBC. It handles CRUD operations and associations of policies with storage entities.

This service uses JdbcTemplate to interact with the database and perform SQL operations related to policies.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
